scope: Selected purchased 15T/4.0 mm metal horn, factory M1.6 attachment, one-piece open root register and assembly clearance; removable paired drive module preserved.
intentional_changes: Use the user-selected horn and confirmed three M1.6 threads. First/third holes attach with two front M1.6x4 screws per side. The 12.2 mm third position is inferred from the seller drawing; outer slot permits +/-0.4 mm radial position adjustment before tightening.

Integral open C root saddle has nominal 0.15 mm radial clearance. The saddle bounds assembly movement without automatic centring; do not force one-sided contact or leave fasteners loose during operation.

Remove four horn nuts and the temporary centring jig. Export finished adapters rather than machining blanks. Keep 12 installed printed parts; fit coupons reduce from 4 to 3; modeled hardware reduces from 62 to 58.
Fill obsolete rear screwdriver scallops in ServoDriveBridge. Input shaft, gear plane, output system, rail and equipment geometry remain unchanged.

Correct service sequence: first remove both output gears and paired servo module; remove input gear and horn screws on bench. Retain the other module parts as obstacles and require successful whole-module removal before bench paths can pass.

independent_transition_audit.scope: Chained AR fixture to first AS candidate to final AS candidate; full differences and classifications retained. Prior AR geometry remains available in the previous Git commit, not as a second active fixture. The archive also retains the final artifact integrity audit.

physical_limits: X06 compatibility is a user-accepted premise, not a measured fit. All three M1.6 threads are user-confirmed.
Horn 3.5 mm total axial envelope, spline recess, installed seating, rounded tip and root concentricity remain unmeasured. Seller dimensions establish front outline and 1.6 mm arm thickness only.

Nominal M1.6x4 grip 2.6 mm, engagement 1.4 mm and rear clearance 0.2 mm require actual screws and useful threads. Minimum flat under-head diameter 3.0 mm and maximum head envelope 3.5 mm are design acceptance limits, not PA12 bearing-strength proof.
No input support bearing is added. Raw PA12 fit, printed shaft socket, gear runout, servo radial loading, clamping torque, creep and installed wire motion remain unqualified.
visual_review_scope: Final full assembly, propulsion, print layout and both optical hosts inspected. Purchased-device shapes and horn axial details remain qualified nominal envelopes; actual leads are not modeled.

mass_comparison.scope: Installed printed BRep at assumed PA12 density; not measured. New horn aluminium-envelope estimate replaces previously unknown horn mass, so hardware subtotal change is not a physical mass comparison.

focused_native_verification.scope: Factory-threaded horn, saved mirrored coupling, minimum head lands, ordered module/drive/servo service and dependent failure propagation. Followed by full native suite on the promoted AS fixture.

native_tests.command: FreeCAD bundled Python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

blender_review.scope: All exported integer-frame native samples, exact CAD-part inventories and visibility, and scene object/action isolation. CAD millimetres become metres with a global X half-turn. Quaternion sign continuity is checked between samples. No continuous-time interpolation, collision, physics, or source-CAD freshness certification is claimed.
